Subject: Follow-up from today's DR tabletop – evidence checklist

Tessa, thanks again for running the tabletop this morning. The exercise covered the primary multi-region failover and a partial DB restore from warm snapshots. To close our audit trail for the SIG/CUSTOMER-SOC pack, we need the following artifacts by EOD next Tuesday (2026-09-01):

- Executive summary of the tabletop (one pager) with scope and participants.
- Timestamped restore logs showing restore start/end and verification steps for the single-shard scenario.
- RTO and RPO measured values for the scenarios exercised, with supporting test vectors.
- A concise list of outstanding gaps and mitigation status (if any).

If you can attach the items or point me to a shared drive, we can route to our risk team and Opal for validation. Also, please confirm whether Redwood will provide a signed attestation that the measured RTO/RPO values are representative of production baseline.

Thanks,

--
Samantha Wu

Samantha.wu@glacierbank.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Tessa / Samantha — attaching the raw restore run file and a short technical note. Key points:

Attachments: [Attachment: restore-run-logs.txt (TXT, 220KB)]

- Restore scenario: single-shard restore from warm snapshot (150GB) to a provisioned recovery instance in us-west-2.
- Measured timings (timestamps in attached log): restore start 2026-08-29T10:08:02Z, data stream complete 2026-08-29T10:35:10Z, verification (checksum & smoke test) complete 2026-08-29T10:38:47Z -> total elapsed 30m45s.
- RPO observed: 90s (snapshot interval + KV cache flush window). This was validated by the sequence number check included in the log.
- Notes on variance: cold-start restores for a full cluster are expected to be higher; the exercised flow used warmed kernels and pre-warmed cache. We flagged expected delta for a multi-shard restore in the gap list.

If the Glacier Bank risk team wants more granular timeline slices (per-file transfer times), I can generate a CSV slice from the log.

--
Marcus Lin
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
